column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Miktam” is spelled “Michtam,” and “I have taken refuge” is rendered “I put my trust.”
NKJV supplies “O my soul” to explain the feminine “you said,” and renders “my good is not beside you” as “My goodness is nothing apart from You.”
Close to the Hebrew; לִקְדוֹשִׁים (“the holy ones”) is rendered “the saints,” and NKJV marks the second line as a quotation.
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “god” after “another.”
Close to the Hebrew; כִלְיוֹתָי (“my kidneys”) is rendered “My heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to security” is rendered “in hope.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲסִידְךָ (“your faithful one”) is capitalized “Your Holy One,” and שָׁחַת (“the pit”) is rendered “corruption.”
